api: No API exit; health 98 ms 2 s before and 103 ms 3 s after; pool idle, no waiters; no job
cause: A reused keep-alive socket closed by the API. The proxy's agent
(apps/studio/vite.config.ts API_AGENT) keeps sockets alive with no idle limit; the API
(apps/api/src/main.ts bootstrap) keeps the Node default keepAliveTimeout of 5 s. Both open
pages poll through that agent (the idle work-queue poll every 15 s, live area polls every
5 s), so a socket idle near 5 s can be reused just as the API closes it.

above it) in bootstrap, or give the proxy agent a shorter idle socket life. Not a server
